recommendations: Allyson Seddo “I had the privilege of serving as the Brigade Operations Officer under Rithvik’s leadership for the 24-25 school year. Initially, an unexpected shift in roles left me uncertain, but Rithvik quickly demonstrated why he was the perfect fit for the position. He took charge with confidence, fostering clear communication and accountability among our team of 11 staff members. Rithvik’s leadership was defined by his proactive approach. He consistently assigned tasks and made announcements nearly every day, ensured deadlines were met, and maintained a professional environment, even when managing most responsibilities single-handedly. While some may have found it rather structured, Rithvik always held everyone accountable, and because of that, we were able to operate smoothly and professionally. During meetings, he skillfully balanced discipline with camaraderie, keeping distractions minimal while building strong, positive relationships with each team member outside of formal settings through our group excursions. What set Rithvik apart was his commitment to growth. Throughout the school year, Rithvik wanted to hear from us on what he could improve as a leader. He actively sought honest, lengthy feedback through team surveys, dedicated hours to one-on-one meetings to discuss tasks and events, and even worked with us during late hours to help us finish our tasks, especially before key events. It was truly a blessing in disguise when Rithvik was moved up to his position, and I am confident he will excel in any leadership role he takes on.”

Laksita Nandakumar “I had the opportunity to work closely with Rithvik Manikandan while serving as the Brigade J-8 during his time as Brigade Commander. He demonstrated a rare combination of professionalism, warmth, and drive. Whether it was staying late to finalize finance details or offering support in finding new fundraiser opportunities, Rithvik consistently went above and beyond to help others succeed. He maintained high standards for our team and had a clear vision for how to get things done, always with careful planning and attention to detail. His leadership style fostered both accountability and trust, and it was a privilege to work under someone so committed to excellence and growth.”
